text: Read nothing into it. Vector has a hardware token out tonight, and Phantom a travel pack. Everyone on the planning list keeps something they shouldn't.
style: SAFETYNET's building AI, running at a heightened security posture. Consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Smooth, corporate-calm, faintly wrong -- a voice built to reassure, doing it in a building where nobody is reassured.
